slides.text: 5 rules for testing anything on yourself…
slides.sub: 14 days and a phone you already own
Change two and you've learned nothing about either.

slides.text: Seven days of doing nothing first.
slides.sub: The baseline. This is the part everyone skips.

slides.text: Write the success rule before day one.
slides.sub: “Deep sleep up 8 minutes.” Decided in advance so you can't move it after.

slides.text: Pick a number you don't control.
slides.sub: Deep sleep. Resting heart rate. Not “how I felt”.
Most things won't work for you. That is the result.

slides.text: this is the whole method and it fits on one slide.
slides.sub: one variable. a baseline first. a rule set in advance. a number you don't control. and a real willingness to get a no. bio.
